Rajwada Palace Banquets — Wedding Venue, Jaipur

Rajwada Palace Banquets is a heritage-style wedding venue in Jaipur with an
ornate indoor banquet hall (capacity ~600) and a sprawling lawn (capacity
~1,200). It is popular for its royal Rajasthani architecture and in-house
lighting setup.

Pricing: a 2021 rate sheet lists the lawn rental at ₹3,50,000 per day. A more
recent enquiry email quotes ₹5,25,000 per day "for the upcoming season," while
the venue's listing on a wedding portal still shows ₹3,50,000. With two
conflicting figures and no clear effective date, request a current written quote
before committing.

Contact: +91 98290 70011 · events@rajwadapalace.example
Location: Tonk Road, Jaipur, Rajasthan
Rating: 4.6 / 5 (157 reviews)

What couples say:
"The royal architecture made for stunning photos."
"Spacious lawn comfortably held our 1,000 guests."
"In-house lighting saved us a separate decor cost."

Rajwada Palace allows outside caterers and decorators with a nominal royalty fee
and provides ample parking plus on-site rooms for the wedding party.
